name: Runner Extras - Session Regional Settings
brief: Proves Evaluate() of a DateTime/Date/Time from text works on the skeleton session.
description: The skeleton NavSession is built with GetUninitializedObject, so its cultureSettings field was default(ClientSettings) — every string pattern null. NavSession.RegionalSettings is a STRUCT, so BC's own `session?.RegionalSettings ?? fallback` in NavSessionOrDefaultProvider can never kick in, and DateTimeParsingHelper.CreateExactDateTimePatterns NRE'd on longTimePattern.Replace(...). Any AL Evaluate() into a DateTime therefore crashed with a bare NullReferenceException.
